name: span_id
description: W3C 16-hex span identifier, deduplicated per landing place to the latest receive_time.

name: parent_span_id
description: Parent span identifier from Bronze _AllSpans (NULL when parentless).

name: span_name
description: OpenTelemetry span name (e.g., generate_content, call_llm, execute_tool, outcome.closed).

name: otel_kind
description: Normalized OpenTelemetry SpanKind (INTERNAL, SERVER, CLIENT, PRODUCER, CONSUMER; NULL on cloud-runtime spans).

name: receive_time
description: Trace-store arrival UTC timestamp ordering duplicate span keys.

name: duration_ms
description: Span execution duration in milliseconds derived from start_time and end_time.

name: span_status
description: Normalized span status from _AllSpans.status.code: OK (1), ERROR (2), or UNSET (0).

name: duplicate_count
description: Count of discarded earlier arrivals for the same (trace_id, span_id) key (0 when unique).

name: trace_state
description: W3C trace_state string preserved verbatim for sampling probability extraction.

name: shape
description: Content telemetry shape (adk_legacy, otel_inline, otel_ref; NULL when span carries no content marker).

name: span_kind
description: Operation-derived span role: model_call, embedding, tool_call, retrieval, memory, agent, workflow, or other (non-convention 0-token ops stay other, ADR-047).

name: is_model_call
description: TRUE on the innermost positive-token span (including tool spans with positive tokens) or explicit model/embedding operation (ADR-042, ADR-045, ADR-047).

name: content_missing
description: TRUE when a non-embedding model or tool call lacks inline content and message reference addresses; FALSE otherwise.

name: source_class
description: Landing-place writer class (platform or application; NULL on cloud-runtime spans without instrumentation scope).

name: app_id
description: Application ID resolved in app_registry via apphub.application.id else (service.name, environment).

name: app_identity_bound
description: TRUE when the span arrived in a landing place registered for app_id; FALSE on mismatch; NULL when app_id is NULL.

name: caller_app_id
description: bq_eval.caller_app_id recorded on platform-class gateway spans for caller ownership precedence.

name: user_id
description: Raw user.id attribute on the span (restricted views only downstream).

name: tenant_id
description: Raw bq_eval.tenant_id attribute on the span (restricted views only downstream).

name: act_chain
description: Ordered multi-hop delegation chain JSON array from bq_eval.act_chain.

name: conversation_id
description: gen_ai.conversation.id (falling back to gcp.vertex.agent.session_id on ADK Format 1 spans).

name: outcome_id
description: EVAL-P11 outcome.id business outcome correlation identifier.

name: outcome_status
description: outcome.status terminal value (succeeded, failed, abandoned, escalated, rejected, denied).

name: outcome_subject
description: outcome.subject business key (restricted outcomes only downstream).

name: eval_run_id
description: bq_eval.eval_run_id evaluation or optimizer sweep identifier.

name: mcp_session_id
description: mcp.session.id linking proxy-mediated client and server tool spans.

name: skill_sha256
description: bq_eval.skill_sha256 hex digest emitted on the span.

name: protected_block_sha256
description: bq_eval.protected_block_sha256 compliance-block hex digest emitted on the span.

name: mounted_skills
description: bq_eval.mounted_skills JSON array (NULL when absent, distinct from empty []).

name: response_model
description: gen_ai.response.model serving model identifier (never defaulted from request_model).

name: upstream_endpoint_location
description: bq_eval.upstream_endpoint_location upstream serving region or multi-region.

name: state_mode
description: bq_eval.state_mode stateless vs stateful ownership mode.

name: thought_signature_present
description: bq_eval.thought_signature_present multi-turn reasoning signature preservation flag.

name: available_tool_count
description: bq_eval.available_tool_count count of tools exposed to the step.

name: selected_tool_names
description: bq_eval.selected_tool_names JSON array of dynamically selected tool names.

name: finish_reason
description: Primary finish reason extracted from gen_ai.response.finish_reasons.

name: action_id
description: bq_eval.action_id binding mutating tool calls to approvals and commits.

name: emitted_args_sha256
description: bq_eval.args_sha256 emitted on proxy or application tool spans.

name: data_source_id
description: gen_ai.data_source.id retrieval or memory corpus identifier.

name: acl_dropped_count
description: bq_eval.acl_dropped_count chunks removed by pre-retrieval ACL filters.

name: job_id
description: db.query.job_id downstream warehouse query job identifier.

name: devai_test_summary
description: bq_eval.devai.test_summary parsed JSON test execution summary.

name: attachment_sha256
description: bq_eval.attachment_sha256 attachment hex digest (restricted views only downstream).

name: app_failed
description: bq_eval.app_failed one-way application crash fact (TRUE when reported true, else NULL).

name: app_failure_reason
description: bq_eval.app_failure_reason diagnostic error string (restricted views only downstream).

name: labels
description: Registered slice-only attributes JSON object (NULL when no registered key is present).
